title: Service Areas A2: Oberhausen - Berlin | Germany Motorway Service & Rest Area
content: The motorway A2 in Germany is a connection from the west to the east side of the country and ends near Berlin. ## Service Areas and Rest Areas on Motorway A2 in Germany. The motorway starts on the west side of the country in a city named "Oberhausen". The end of the motorway A2 in Germany is next to Berlin at the motorway A10. The sequence of rest areas and service areas on the motorway in Germany is shown in your driving direction. This list of the German motorway service areas starts at the beginning of the motorway. * **Rhynern South** (Petrol Station, Toilet, Food Supply). * **Gütersloh South** (Petrol Station, Toilet, Food Supply). * **Lipperland** (Petrol Station, Toilet, Food Supply). * **Auetal South** (Petrol Station, Toilet, Food Supply). * **Börde South** (Petrol Station, Toilet, Food Supply). * **Buckautal South** (Petrol Station, Toilet, Food Supply). This list of the Germany motorway service areas starts at the end of the motorway.

title: A 2 (Germany) - AARoads Wiki
content: # A 2 (Germany). |  | You can help **expand this article with text translated from the corresponding article "de:A 2 (Germany)") in German**. * You may also add the template `{{Translated|de|A 2 (Germany)}}` to the talk page "Talk:A 2 (Germany)"). `{{Translated|de|A 2 (Germany)}}`. ***Bundesautobahn 2*** (German for 'Federal Motorway 2', short form **Autobahn 2**, abbreviated as **BAB 2** or **A 2**) is an autobahn in Germany that connects the Ruhr area in the west to Berlin in the east. The A 2 was modified in the late 1990s, and completely rebuilt in the former East Germany. In the area of Hanover, it was natural for the motorway to pass shortly to the south of the city. As Hanover was at that time one of the hubs of German air traffic and the airport was in the north of the city, it was decided, however, for a northern bypass of the city.
